request.initial_prompt: "With her constitution she should have lived to a good old age: her life was shortened by trouble." And then a spasm constricted her mouth for an instant: as it passed away she turned and left the room, and so did I. Neither of us had dropt a tear.

raw_segments.text: With her constitution she should have lived to a good old age, her life was shortened by trouble, and then a spasm constricted her mouth for an instant.
As it passed away she turned and left the room, and so did I. Neither of us had dropped a tear.
